spells.name: Tidal Lance
spells.components: V, S, M (a shard of sea glass)
spells.description:
A spear of pressurised seawater erupts from your hand in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

A creature that fails is also pushed 10 feet away from you.
spells.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

spells.name: Brine Bolt
spells.description: You hurl a globule of caustic brine. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Acid damage.
spells.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

spells.name: Kelp Mending
spells.description: Living kelp knits a creature's wounds. The target regains Hit Points equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

species.name: Coralborn
species.description: Coralborn are people whose skin bears living reef patterns.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: You can breathe air and water.

features.name: Reef Skin
features.description: When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Tidecall
features.description: As a Magic action you cast *Fog Cloud*.

classes.name: Tidewarden
classes.description: Wardens of the shoreline who channel the sea's patience and fury.

features.name: Undertow
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, roll your Surge Die (@scale.tidewarden.surge-die) and add it to the damage.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Deep
subclasses.description: Wardens sworn to the lightless trenches.

features.name: Crushing Depths
features.description: When you use Undertow, the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Pressure Adapted
features.description: You gain resistance to Bludgeoning damage.

feats.name: Sea Legs
feats.description: You gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and you have Advantage on saving throws to avoid being knocked Prone while on a ship.
